key_point: Nintendo's president halved his own salary rather than lay off staff
title: When the Wii U failed, Nintendo's president cut his own pay in half instead of firing staf
caption: When the Wii U failed, Nintendo's president cut his own pay in half instead of firing staff. #gamefacts #didyouknow #gaming #nintendo #satoruiwata #wiiu

instagram.caption:
When the Wii U failed, Nintendo's president cut his own pay in half instead of firing staff.

Satoru Iwata said people who fear losing their jobs can't make games that impress the world. So in 2014 he took the hit himself.

He started out as a programmer and once said: "On my business card, I am a corporate president. In my mind, I am a game developer. But in my heart, I am a gamer."

What's your favorite Nintendo memory?
